result.title: ROSETTA: Rotation Subspace Estimation for Training-free Transmodal Alignment
result.comment: 18 pages, including supplementary material. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Image Processing on March 1, 2026
result.summary: When a query must be matched against a database built with a different sensor or processed by a different encoder, the independently trained encoders impose distinct coordinate systems on the feature space. No canonical reference frame exists to which all encoders can be aligned, and no single training procedure has fully closed this gap. We show that the relative transformation between any two such systems is a spatially preserving rotation in whitened feature space, whose angular velocity exhibits white-noise characteristics: large in norm, temporally uncorrelated, and unpredictable from the features themselves. However, the cross-covariance between encoder outputs has low effective rank, constraining only a small fraction of the rotation parameters, therefore local alignment is tractable. ROSETTA is a training-free calibration layer that estimates the local rotation via an expectation-maximization procedure, requiring no coobservation at query time. We validate ROSETTA on three public driving datasets spanning LiDAR, camera, thermal, and event modalities in cross-modal, cross-device, cross-representation, and cross-backbone settings, with milliseconds overhead per query.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ROSETTA，一个免训练校准层：把不同编码器特征空间之间的相对变换刻画为白化特征空间中的保距旋转，利用交叉协方差低有效秩的性质，用 EM 估计局部旋转子空间，查询时无需共同观测，并在 LiDAR、相机、热成像与事件等多模态驾驶数据上验证对齐效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「白化空间中低有效秩旋转子空间 + EM 局部对齐」的思路，可能为 LVR 中跨编码器/跨模态 latent 状态的对齐与 latent 相似度结构分析提供可核查的方法线索，但论文本身不涉及推理状态生成或答案使用，迁移性需人工核查。
